items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I had an opportunity to work with Billy Eckstein. Yeah. So I worked with Billy Eckstein a while, see?

ctx.x: Bring it up to date, if you like. All right. In the late years, well, I mean, I played with, uh, I played with J. McShane's orchestra. I stayed with him quite a while. Was that in Kansas City, or where? No, I joined him in New Orleans. He had played a date at the rhythm club here in New Orleans, and I joined J. McShane here. And, uh, then I went away with him. And I left him for a while, because he didn't have too much work, and I had an opportunity to work with Billy Eckstein. Yeah. So I worked with Billy…
Is that where you took, uh, Dizzy Gillespie's place with Billy Eckstein?
